content:
Just after catching AirPods Pro 3 hitting one of their lowest prices ever, the fall Prime Day deals are now flowing toward the latest Mac lineup. The all-new M6 Mac mini has hit a new all-time low with up to nearly $150 off, while the 2026 Mac Studio is also seeing nearly $200 in savings.

Beyond those deals, every M5 MacBook Air configuration is also $200 off, the M5 Pro MacBook Pro continues to offer a $500 discount, Apple's brand-new bare-characters minimalist Magic Keyboard is getting its first discount, and the Magic Mouse is seeing a rare price cut as well.

If you're looking at the MacBook lineup, fall Prime Day is bringing the lowest prices in months on the Apple MacBook Air M5 series. Amazon is currently offering a solid $200 off across virtually every configuration, with most models also available in multiple colors:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,399 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,299 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,599 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (originally $1,999)

Amazon this morning brought significant markdowns across Apple's new Mac mini lineup. From the entry-level M6 configurations all the way up to models with the more powerful M5 Max, prices are now down by up to $149, hitting new all-time lows:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (originally $899) — all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (originally $1,099) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,550 (originally $1,699) — all-time low

Beyond those, the new Mac Studio equipped with 36GB of RAM has also hit its lowest price ever, with Amazon currently taking $199 off — the best discount since its launch last month:

  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio $2,300 (originally $2,499) — all-time low

While we're still waiting for (and hoping to see) more MacBook Pro deals, Amazon is still offering up to $500 off on this upgraded 2TB configuration, a discount that brings its price $100 below its official MSRP before the price hike:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (originally $3,199)

Beyond that, we've also spotted multiple discounts on Apple Mac accessories. Specifically, both the black and white Magic Mouse are enjoying a rare near-25% discount, while Apple's brand-new Magic Keyboard — featuring a minimalist full-characters key design — is also seeing its first markdown:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (new 2026 model) $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse white $60 (originally $79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse black $80 (originally $99)
